shared_elements: tall upright rectangular slab carved in low relief
horizontal band of small repeated motifs across the upper part
division of the surface into stacked registers/panels
figures shown frontally or in profile within a framed field
small repeated units read as a row (animal heads in A, sign-like blocks in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both are tall upright slabs carved in low relief with content organised into stacked registers, including a band of small repeated units near the top. What is actually depicted differs completely — A shows schematic outline animals (a row of quadrupeds, birds in profile, a snake, a fox-like beast) with no humans, while B shows an elaborately dressed anthropomorphic figure enthroned within an ornate frame above dense panels of sign-blocks, rendered with far more detailed, crowded modelling.
